industry: Coin-op / self-serve laundromats, wash-dry-fold, pickup & delivery laundry, and hybrid dry-cleaning drop-off
words_and_claims_to_avoid: Unqualified 'eco', 'green', 'planet-friendly', 'non-toxic' detergent or process claims without competent, specific substantiation (FTC Green Guides, 16 CFR 260.4 / 260.2)
'Official' / census / government-looking notices about laundry requirements (39 USC 3001)
'Same-day' / '24-hour' turnaround that the store cannot keep; 'always ready in X hours' without conditions
'Lowest prices in town' / 'cheapest wash' without a defined, testable basis (FTC s.5)
Fake scarcity ('only today') if the offer runs indefinitely
Membership/app 'unlimited washes' that hide fees, auto-renew, or geographic limits
Senior discounts presented as if all laundry buyers are seniors without a real program
compliance_notes: FTC Act s.5 + 16 CFR 233/251: percent-off, dollar-off, and free soap/dry/fold need a bona fide regular price and clear conditions next to the offer.
FTC Green Guides (16 CFR Part 260): general environmental benefit claims for detergent or 'eco laundry' usually require qualification and scientific substantiation — prefer specific, limited claims.
39 USC 3001: no government look-alike EDDM or 'mandatory laundry notice' mailers.
Turnaround and pickup promises: if advertised, they must be typically achievable; print service area, minimums, and exclusions.
Loyalty/app memberships with auto-renew: ROSCA (online) and state ARL (e.g., CA B&P 17600 et seq.) disclosure/cancel rules may apply.
Price advertising for self-serve vend prices: do not bait with a machine size that is rarely available; state which washers the promo covers.
If promoting dry cleaning drop-off operated by a third party, do not imply in-house processing if false.
standing_rules: Emotion-agnostic: fear, joy, relief, status, belonging are fine when they fit and stay legal.
Every angle and emotion_by_offer combo carries sell_the_outcome_line.
Vendor ROI labeled agency-only unverified; never print as fact on a client card.
Prefer one clear offer + one real photo + one QR (roofing-round5 directional) unless client insists on a coupon grid.
No age/senior default unless the client has a real discount and evidence supports targeting.

emotion_by_offer.what_backfires: Hidden minimum weight; 'first order' undefined; stacking exclusions in micro type

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Gold multi-coupon fronts (e.g., five dry-cleaning tiers) vs roofing-round5 single-offer preference
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Patrick directional votes prefer one hero offer; coupon grids remain legal if truthful. Default to one offer on the mail face.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: 'Eco/green laundry' marketing common in industry vs FTC Green Guides
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Compliance wins: no unqualified green claims; only specific, substantiated environmental statements.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Vendor/gallery ROI absence vs desire for response proof
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Leave thin; do not invent lift. Label any future vendor cases agency-only unverified.
